differences.what: the upper storey carried along the west face as a wall rising through the roof, two small sash in it (x 1137-1179 and 1279-1329 px) and its cornice at about 6.0 m
differences.how: T-3193: the upper wall on the west face from the north block to the corner, sash at 4.3 m sills; the render's within about 10 px
